description: This Java source file defines the RssService class, which is an Android Service responsible for periodically fetching and updating RSS feed data. It handles network communication, RSS parsing, and notification management within the Android environment.

classes.name: RssService
classes.description: An Android Service that manages fetching, parsing, and updating RSS feeds periodically. It handles network operations, feed parsing, last update tracking, and user notifications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the service, sets up notifications, content resolver, last checked time, and starts the background thread for periodic updates.

methods.name: onStart
methods.description: Handles intents to trigger instant requerying of RSS feeds or adding new RSS URLs based on received extras.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cleans up resources like cancelling the notification when the service is destroyed.

methods.name: queryIfPeriodicRefreshRequired
methods.description: Determines whether it's time to fetch RSS feeds again based on last checked timestamp and schedules the next check.

methods.name: queryRssItems
methods.description: Requeries all stored RSS feeds, updating their contents if newer data is available, and resets the last checked time.

methods.name: queryItem
methods.description: Fetches and updates a single RSS feed given its URL, parsing the feed and updating the local database if newer content is found.

methods.name: parseRssDocPubDate
methods.description: Extracts and parses the <pubDate> XML element from the RSS XML string, returning a GregorianCalendar of the publication date.

methods.name: readRss
methods.description: Reads the RSS feed content from a URL and returns it as a string.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Callback for scheduling periodic RSS feed checks.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Provides the binder object for clients binding to the service.
